title: (fix) O3-5991: Allow post-registration redirects to non-SPA URLs
body:

See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [x] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

`BeforeSavePrompt` unconditionally stripped the SPA base from its target URL before navigating:

    navigate({ to: `\${openmrsSpaBase}/${getUrlWithoutPrefix(target)}` });

`getUrlWithoutPrefix` splits on `getOpenmrsSpaBase()` and returns index [1], so a URL that does not live under the SPA base yields `undefined`, which the template literal stringifies. Any such target navigated to `/openmrs/spa/undefined`.

This affects implementations that bridge O3 to legacy OpenMRS pages: a `links.submitButton` such as
`${openmrsBase}/patientDashboard.form?patientId=${patientUuid}` was unusable, as was the `afterUrl` query parameter, which shares the path. Navigating away from a dirty registration form to a non-SPA page failed the same way.

The stripping is only needed for the `cancelNavigation` caller, where `target` comes from single-spa's `evt.detail.newUrl` and includes the origin. When there is no SPA-relative portion to extract, pass the URL through unchanged; `navigate` already routes non-SPA paths to `window.location.assign`, so no change is needed in esm-core.
